Content-Type.description: Indicates the input mime type. Valid values: text/html; text/xml; text/raw; application/pdf.

x-ag-access-token.description: Relevant only to free Open Calais and Hosted Premium Intelligent Tagging. The value of this header is your license key.

x-calais-selectiveTags.description: Determines which of the Intelligent Tagging processes are triggered.
